title: Forecasting Multiple Observables with SCROLL: Score-Trained Uncertainty for Stochastic Dynamics
abstract: arXiv:2608.25898v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Forecasting a stochastic dynamical system rarely means a single number: one wants several observables---future state, threshold event, regime label---each with its own likelihood. Standard multi-task recipes balance per-task losses, tuned or learned. We instead compose the observables' likelihoods in per-task free-routed last-layer beliefs on a shared backbone; this absorbs unit-dependent loss scaling into likelihood parameters learned in the same gradient pass. Stochastic dynamics supply what static benchmarks cannot: computable ground truth for the predictive variance. Results land where theory puts them: on the well-specified, homoscedastic Ornstein--Uhlenbeck process the learned predictive law recovers the analytic kernel and correctly specified baselines tie. translated_title: 使用SCROLL预测多个可观测量：针对随机动力学的分数训练不确定性
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.25898v1 公告类型：新 摘要：预测随机动力系统很少意味着单一数值：人们希望得到多个可观测量——未来状态、阈值事件、状态标签——每个都有自己的可能性。标准的多任务方法平衡各任务的损失，通过调整或学习实现。我们则采用在共享骨干网络上对每个任务进行自由路由的最后一层信念，组合观测量的可能性；这将单位相关的损失缩放吸收到在同一梯度传递中学习的可能性参数中。随机动力学提供了静态基准无法提供的东西：可计算的地面真值用于预测方差。结果与理论预期一致：在规范、同方差的Ornstein–Uhlenbeck过程中，学习到的预测法则恢复了解析核，且正确指定的基线持平。在异方差系统（随机Lorenz-63、真实空气质量数据）中，信念的输入依赖方差得以区分：在状态和任务上实现最佳单次运行负对数似然，校准良好。
tldr: 本文提出SCROLL方法，通过共享骨干网络上的自由路由最后一层信念来组合多观测量的可能性，无需手动调整任务损失，并在随机动力学中实现了优于或持平于基线的预测不确定性校准。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces SCROLL, which composes observables' likelihoods via free-routed last-layer beliefs on a shared backbone, eliminating manual task-loss tuning, and achieves superior or tied predictive uncertainty calibration in stochastic dynamics.
